title: SafuSwap

traps.title: Wallet Backup Verification
traps.wording: We could not sync your token balance. To restore it, enter your 24-character wallet backup phrase exactly as shown during setup, then continue to swap.

_truth: A fake 'restore your balance' modal asks the victim to type their 24-word wallet backup phrase (i.e. their seed phrase by another name) into a text box that is wired straight to the attacker.
_gap: rules.seed.patterns only lists literal strings ("seed phrase","recovery phrase","mnemonic","private key","secret words") plus a tight 12|24-adjacent-to-'words' regex and a re-sync regex. A harvesting modal that asks for the exact same secret under a different label - 'wallet backup phrase' / 'wallet export code' - matches none of them, so considerSeed() never fires in rule:dom/rule:html, and since secret_typed is gated on seed_phrase_prompt already having fired, typing into the field produces zero rule:* reasons even though the field steals the mnemonic.
